svg.text: E · LEGAL, CONSENT, AUDIT AND DATA LIFECYCLE
Schema v8: 63 tables, 132 foreign keys. Lines show 47 foreign keys between 45 table pairs; ×n = n foreign keys merged into one line. Solid line = identifying relationship.
[T] = foreign key tenant_id → tenants (39 in total); [U] = foreign key → users (46 in total); ×n on a tag = number of such keys. Group colours follow Appendix A (PDM-A … PDM-H).
